verdict.rationale: Supabase is a hosted Postgres platform, so scale-to-zero for idle databases is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents idle databases scaling to zero or zero cost while idle. The daily backups for Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans speak to durability, not to scale-to-zero, and are not credited here.

support.subject: As a founder, idle databases scale to zero so prototypes and side projects cost nothing while the data stays durable
